evidence.name: Screen field: Upload the featured image
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Upload the featured image" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Upload the featured image
sections.description: Upload (or clear) the hero image shown at the top of the paywall. Use a high-resolution image with its subject centered, since the edges may be cropped depending on your fit setting. If your funnel runs in multiple languages you can upload a different image per language; it appears only when media type is Image, and nothing shows until you upload one.
